title: Shared site data
scope: The main and alt sites share settings, records and daily stamina within this userscript. Persistent and Isekai stay separate. Sharing starts with the first site's settings. Both sites' old settings are backed up below.
confirm: Use this backup on both sites? You can restore the current settings later. Auto-battle will pause.
quotaHelp: To avoid counting battles twice, we keep the larger of the two old totals. Open both sites once, then adjust today's earlier usage here if needed. New battles count separately.
resetScope: Also deletes shared settings and records on the main and alt sites, for both worlds.
fail: Could not save shared data. Your original data is kept.
